caption: The drawing features a single female figure standing against a plain, off-white background. The figure wears a long dress with a red and white checkered pattern and ruffled hem, covering her legs nearly down to the ankles. Over the dress, she has on a dark brown, patterned, knee-length coat with wide cuffs, a flared bottom, and a buttoned front. The woman’s hands are clasped together in front of her body, partially obscured by the coat’s sleeves. She has a pale complexion and black hair styled in short curls. On her head, she wears a bright red bonnet tied under her chin with a bow. Her footwear consists of pink Victorian-style buttoned boots. There are no additional objects or background elements in the composition, aside from the artist's signature in red at the lower right corner.
title: Doll - "Flora Richardson"
